entities.name: Ventricular septal defect
observations: Infant presentation with holosystolic lower-left-sternal-border murmur, pulmonary plethora, and left atrial/ventricular enlargement is consistent with a hemodynamically significant VSD.

entities.name: Postnatal PVR decline
observations: After birth, pulmonary vascular resistance decreases, increasing left-to-right flow across a VSD and causing pulmonary overcirculation and left-sided volume loading; symptoms may emerge in early infancy.
